fullPassage: If you want to bring something into shared reality for the purpose of social coordination, you have to describe it, or at the very least label it. Even the ideally objective pursuit of science is unable to escape the framing effects of language. Like all collective culture, science is constructed on report, reason, debate, negotiation, justification, consensus, and, most important, coordination. And all of these things depend on language. Even something as fundamental as particle physics depends on language in a particular way. I don’t mean that particle physics wouldn’t exist if we didn’t describe it. Particle physics is part of brute reality and so it will carry on independent of any human agreement or understanding of what it is. But consider this remark by Michael I. Jordan, referring to the “infinite potential well” model, which studies how a single particle behaves in a small, enclosed space: “A particle in a potential well is optimizing a function called the Lagrangian function. The particle doesn’t know that. There’s no algorithm running that does that. It just happens. It’s a description mathematically of something that helps us understand as analysts what’s happening.”

❌ ③ scattered: scattered(흩어진)는 밀폐와 반대 의미
❌ ④ released: released(풀려난)는 밀폐와 반대 의미
det.tip: enclosed = confined = 밀폐된, 가두어진

questions.passage: If you want to bring something into shared reality for the purpose of social coordination, you have to describe it, or at the very least label it. Even the ideally <u>objective</u> pursuit of science is unable to escape the framing effects of language. Like all collective culture, science is constructed on report, reason, debate, negotiation, justification, consensus, and, most important, coordination. And all of these things depend on language. Even something as fundamental as particle physics depends on language in a particular way. I don’t mean that particle physics wouldn’t exist if we didn’t describe it. Particle physics is part of brute reality and so it will carry on independent of any human agreement or understanding of what it is. But consider this remark by Michael I. Jordan, referring to the “infinite potential well” model, which studies how a single particle behaves in a small, enclosed space: “A particle in a potential well is optimizing a function called the Lagrangian function. The particle doesn’t know that. There’s no algorithm running that does that. It just happens. It’s a description mathematically of something that helps us understand as analysts what’s happening.”
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 objective와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① rational: rational(합리적인)은 objective와 유사한 인지적 특성
❌ ② empirical: empirical(경험적인)은 객관성과 의미축이 다름 (방법론 vs 태도)
✅ ③ biased: biased(편향된)는 objective(객관적인)의 반의어 ←정답
❌ ④ logical: logical(논리적인)은 objective와 유사한 분석적 특성
det.tip: objective(객관적인) ↔ biased(편향된) — 공정성의 대조

questions.passage:
(A) She performed <u>well</u> in the final examination, earning the highest score in her class.
(B) In quantum mechanics, a particle trapped in a potential <u>well</u> can only exist at certain discrete energy levels.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 well의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: well: (A) 잘 (부사) / (B) 물리학 용어 '퍼텐셜 우물' (입자가 갇히는 에너지 공간)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 잘 — (B) 잘: (B)에서 well은 부사가 아닌 명사(물리학 용어)
❌ ② (A) 우물 — (B) 잘: (A)에서 well은 명사가 아닌 부사, (B)는 부사가 아닌 명사
❌ ③ (A) 잘 — (B) 우물: (B)는 일상적 '우물'이 아닌 물리학 전문 용어 '퍼텐셜 우물'
✅ ④ (A) 잘 — (B) (물리학) 퍼텐셜 우물: (A)는 부사 '잘', (B)는 물리학 전문 용어 ←정답
det.tip: well: ① (부사) 잘 ② (명사/물리학) 포텐셜 웰 — 본문의 infinite potential well에서 유래

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a general agreement among a group of people"

✅ ② consensus: consensus(합의)는 '집단의 일반적 동의'라는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ debate: debate(토론)는 의견 교환 과정이지 동의 자체가 아님
❌ ④ justification: justification(정당화)은 근거 제시이지 집단 동의가 아님
det.tip: consensus = 합의, 의견 일치. 본문: science is constructed on ... consensus

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.tip: the ideally objective pursuit — 이상적으로 객관적인 추구. 명사→형용사 변환

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)
